## Where streaming is implemented

**Core transport (low-level SSE parsing):** `src/core/streaming.ts`
- `class Stream<Item>` — wraps a `fetch` `Response` body, implements `AsyncIterable<Item>`
- `Stream.fromSSEResponse()` — parses `text/event-stream` bytes into typed JSON items
- `Stream.fromReadableStream()` — parses a newline-delimited JSON `ReadableStream`
- `_iterSSEMessages()` / `iterSSEChunks()` / `SSEDecoder` — low-level SSE framing (splits on `\n\n`, parses `event:`/`data:` fields)
- `.tee()`, `.toReadableStream()` — stream utilities

**Central dispatch point:** `src/internal/parse.ts`, function `defaultParseResponse()`. When a request's `FinalRequestOptions.stream` is `true`, it calls either `props.options.__streamClass.fromSSEResponse(...)` (if a resource specified a custom stream class) or falls back to the base `Stream.fromSSEResponse(...)`. This is the single choke point where every streaming HTTP response gets turned into an async-iterable object — evidence: `src/internal/parse.ts` lines ~26–36.

**Higher-level, event-emitting wrappers** (built on top of the core `Stream`, adding accumulation/parsing/events):
- `src/lib/EventStream.ts` — base `EventStream` class (`.on()`, `.off()`, `.once()`, `.emitted()`, `._emit()`)
- `src/lib/ChatCompletionStream.ts` — `ChatCompletionStream` (extends `AbstractChatCompletionRunner`, which extends `EventStream`); accumulates `ChatCompletionChunk`s into a snapshot, emits `content`, `chunk`, etc. Static factory `ChatCompletionStream.createChatCompletion()` overrides `_createChatCompletion()` to call `client.chat.completions.create({...params, stream:true})` and iterate the resulting core `Stream`.
- `src/lib/ChatCompletionStreamingRunner.ts` — extends `ChatCompletionStream`, adds automatic tool-call execution (`runTools`).
- `src/lib/responses/ResponseStream.ts` — `ResponseStream`, static `ResponseStream.createResponse()`; calls `client.responses.create({...params, stream:true})` or `client.responses.retrieve(id, {stream:true})` and `for await`s the raw `Stream<ResponseStreamEvent>`, accumulating a full `Response` via `ResponseAccumulator.ts`.
- `src/lib/AssistantStream.ts` — `AssistantStream` (Assistants/Threads API, deprecated in favor of Responses), with factories `createThreadAssistantStream`, `createAssistantStream`, `createToolAssistantStream`.
- `src/lib/AbstractChatCompletionRunner.ts` — shared base for both streaming and non-streaming chat-completion runners.

## Public API methods that route into streaming

| Public method | File | Mechanism |
|---|---|---|
| `client.chat.completions.create(body, opts)` with `body.stream: true` | `src/resources/chat/completions/completions.ts` | returns raw `Stream<ChatCompletionChunk>` via core dispatch |
| `client.chat.completions.stream(body, opts)` | same file | `ChatCompletionStream.createChatCompletion()` |
| `client.chat.completions.runTools(body, opts)` with `body.stream: true` | same file | `ChatCompletionStreamingRunner.runTools()` |
| `client.responses.create(body, opts)` with `stream: true` | `src/resources/responses/responses.ts` | raw `Stream<ResponseStreamEvent>` |
| `client.responses.retrieve(id, {stream:true}, opts)` | same file | raw `Stream<ResponseStreamEvent>` |
| `client.responses.stream(body, opts)` | same file | `ResponseStream.createResponse()` |
| `client.completions.create(body, opts)` (legacy `/completions`) with `stream:true` | `src/resources/completions.ts` | raw `Stream<Completion>` |
| `client.images.edit(body, opts)` / `.generate(body, opts)` with `stream:true` | `src/resources/images.ts` | raw `Stream<ImageEditStreamEvent>` / `Stream<ImageGenStreamEvent>` |
| `client.beta.threads.createAndRun(body, opts)` with `stream:true` (deprecated) | `src/resources/beta/threads/threads.ts` | raw `Stream<AssistantStreamEvent>` |
| `client.beta.threads.createAndRunStream(body, opts)` (deprecated) | same file | `AssistantStream.createThreadAssistantStream()` |
| `client.beta.threads.runs.stream(threadId, body, opts)` / `.createAndStream(...)` (deprecated) | `src/resources/beta/threads/runs/runs.ts` | `AssistantStream.createAssistantStream()` |
| `client.beta.threads.runs.submitToolOutputsStream(...)` (deprecated) | same file | `AssistantStream.createToolAssistantStream()` |

All of these ultimately bottom out at `src/internal/parse.ts`'s `defaultParseResponse()`, which is the actual place the SSE `Response` gets turned into a `Stream` object, using either the base class or a resource-supplied `__streamClass`.
